name: radar-vagas-dev
description: Agregador de vagas de desenvolvimento (fullstack, front-end, back-end) do Brasil, Portugal e EUA, com filtro de vagas de IA / vibe coding.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
